summary: Smith County, TN tower at about 1,106 ft, listed as still standing in a March 2014 Tennessee fire tower table; no build date, design or history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as still standing in a table dated March 26, 2014, and marked standing on the Tennessee Landforms index with no date; no later visit or photo found

events.note: Listed among extant Tennessee fire towers as of March 26, 2014 in the Division of Forestry tower study

notes_for_editor: Evidence is thin, as for Gill Chapel: the Tennessee Landforms index entry and the 2014 extant table only. No build date, design, height, staffing, fire history or access source found. Unverified lead: online business directories (MapQuest, Chamber of Commerce, us-info) list a 'Gordonsville Fire Tower' at 121 Pig Branch Rd, giving the town as Brush Creek in one and Gordonsville in another. MapQuest returned no text and Chamber of Commerce returned 403, so the listing could not be read or quoted and is not linked to this lookout in the story. The town also has a modern fire department, not checked against the tower. The brief's record matches the sources (1,106 ft = 337.1 m, Smith County, standing), so no corrections. The 2014 form's signature block is blank in our copy.
